sentences.text: The documents state conflicting waiting periods for pre-existing diseases: 36 months of continuous coverage in the endorsement, and 24 months of continuous coverage in the FAQ.

The endorsement says that, with effect from April 1, 2026, Clause 4.2 is substituted to read that expenses related to pre-existing diseases are covered only after a waiting period of 36 months of continuous coverage.
